Product Details: The Dong Cheng DSS125B Straight Grinder is a reliable and powerful tool built for a wide range of metal grinding applications. Powered by a 710W high-quality motor, it delivers strong performance at a no-load speed of 5300 RPM, making it ideal for grinding welds, rust removal, deburring, smoothing, and removing sharp edges. The straight body design allows for better control and easy handling in tight and narrow spaces, while the ergonomic rear handle ensures a comfortable grip during extended use. Safety is enhanced by the semi-enclosed thickened wheel guard, which effectively deflects sparks and debris. The convenient lock-on button enables continuous operation without constant pressure, and the durable aluminium spindle housing ensures long service life. The external carbon brush structure makes replacement quick and hassle-free. The tool supports a maximum wheel diameter of 125mm and weighs just 4.3kg. Accessories included are a spanner wrench, flange nut, and a replacement carbon brush. Please note that the grinding wheel is not included. Always wear proper safety gear while operating this tool.
